description: This file implements request wait group management and graceful shutdown handling for the Kubernetes API server, including functions to add requests to a wait group, handle long-running requests, and respond with retry instructions during shutdown.

classes.name: RequestWaitGroup
classes.description: Interface for managing a wait group for requests, allowing thread-safe addition and completion tracking.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds delta to the wait group counter, may be negative, similar to sync.WaitGroup.

methods.name: WithWaitGroup
methods.description: Wraps an HTTP handler to include request counting for graceful shutdown, considering long-running requests.
